We’re sorry money’s a bit tight right now — we understand wanting to make the most of your budget. While we can’t compare specific products here, we can help you save on how you pay and ship:

Shipping options:

Free Shipping – $0
Standard – $8
Expedited – $15
Rush – $30
Choosing Free Shipping is the most budget‑friendly.

Pay-over-time options (if you’re eligible in the US):

Afterpay lets you pay in 4 interest‑free installments due bi‑weekly. First payment is at purchase, then 3 automatic payments from your card. Late fees may apply if funds aren’t available.
Klarna also requires you to be 18+, with a US-issued debit/credit card, US billing address, and SMS-capable phone number.

Using HSA/FSA benefits:

If you don’t have enough funds on an HSA/FSA card, you currently cannot split across multiple HSA/FSA cards. You could instead pay with a regular credit card and, if using a Flex-type service, submit the itemized receipt for reimbursement (where applicable).
If you don’t have an HSA/FSA card but have benefits, select an option like “Flex | Pay with HSA/FSA” at checkout and pay with a regular credit card; you’ll receive an itemized receipt to submit to your provider.

Based on this, to stretch your budget we’d generally suggest:

Choose Free Shipping whenever timing allows.
Consider Afterpay (or Klarna, if you meet the requirements) to spread payments interest‑free, but keep track of due dates to avoid late fees.
If you have HSA/FSA benefits, use the Flex-style checkout plus reimbursement to offset costs where eligible.

If you share which specific Dermalogica products you’re choosing between and your main skin concerns, we can help you prioritize what to buy now and what can wait.
